stories.title: Lawyer says Shah Mahmood Qureshi taken to hospital days after suffering fall
stories.brief: LAHORE: The lawyer representing Shah Mahmood Qureshi said on Tuesday that the senior PTI leader, who is currently incarcerated at Kot Lakhpat jail, was taken to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology (PIC) days after suffering a fall.

stories.title: Shah Mahmood rushed to Punjab Institute of Cardiology after reported prison collapse
stories.brief: Senior PTI leader Shah Mahmood Qureshi was on Tuesday transferred to Lahore's Punjab Institute of Cardiology (PIC) after reportedly collapsing inside Kot Lakhpat jail, prompting his family to seek urgent medical investigations and treatment. I learnt of my father Shah Mahmood Qureshi's fall from family after they met him in Kot Lakhpat jail today.

stories.brief: The appointment was made after it emerged Jensen Huang had an affair with a woman believed to be a spy for China.

stories.title: PM Shehbaz arrives in Turkiye to address COP31 summit
stories.brief: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif arrived in Antalya, Turkiye, on Tuesday for a three-day visit to attend the Leaders’ Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties (COP 31) to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC).

stories.title: Israel's parliament sworn in as Eisenkot tries to forge a government
stories.brief: Israel’s parliament was sworn in on Tuesday without a new government, after a deadlocked general election stripped Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of his parliamentary majority but left his main rivals with no clear path to power.

stories.title: ‘Hatred should come to an end’: Gohar defends interaction with ex-army chief Bajwa amid criticism
stories.brief: PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan on Tuesday defended his brief interaction with former army chief Gen Qamar Javed Bajwa, saying political hostilities should end, and clarified that the two had merely exchanged greetings at a wedding.

stories.title: NAB issues second notice to JUI-F chief's son over alleged 'illegal appointments' in Pakistan Post
stories.brief: NAB officials declared his response unsatisfactory and issued a fresh notice, directing him to appear in person at 11am on Friday. NAB had earlier summoned Rehman's son on November 5 over alleged irregularities in the appointments at the PPOD during his tenure.

stories.brief: The report said that at least 112 foreign nationals in total had died in police and immigration detention facilities in Greece since 2000, with authorities failing to maintain a reliable public record of the deaths.
